performance.threshold: No numeric threshold is specified for this configuration-only story.

reliability.evidence: The manifest-and-lockfile source-policy gate with mandatory node link and non-link workspace-target checks, explicitly hardened frozen npm ci dry run, and complete make preflight all exited 0.

operability.evidence: The source-policy CLI passed for the repository without reading .npmrc, rejected deterministic source and lock bypass fixtures including SCP Git, workspace shrinkwrap, explicit-null links, malformed SRI, and malformed shapes, and real npm rejected a temporary directory dependency with EALLOWDIRECTORY.

limitations: The deterministic contract suite does not query dynamic registry publication timestamps.
The release-age hold reduces exposure to fresh releases but does not establish that an older package is safe.
